Jorge Coca is Head of Engineering at Very Good Ventures, Google's #1 recommended Flutter agency. A Google Developer Expert in Flutter, Jorge previously led Android and Flutter development at BMW, delivering the automaker's first Flutter-powered production app. 

At VGV he has led Flutter projects for Toyota, Google, and enterprise clients across automotive, travel, and entertainment. He is based in Chicago and is passionate about helping teams succeed with Flutter at scale.

speakers.name: Josh Bayne
speakers.tagLine: Founding Engineer | AWS AI League Champion London 2026
speakers.bio:
Josh Bayne is an AI Engineer at Maiven with a background in data engineering and a Master’s degree in Physics, working on LLM systems, agent orchestration, and production AI tooling. His work focuses on practical approaches to building AI systems that are reliable, observable, and easier to reason about in real-world environments, with a strong emphasis on experimentation, measurement, and keeping complexity under control.

Josh was the winner of the AWS AI League London finals, where he built an autonomous AI agent using Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore capable of navigating dynamic environments, solving coding and logic tasks, and adapting under time pressure. His approach focused on simple, reactive system design rather than heavily layered prompting or orchestration.

Outside of AI, Josh enjoys video games, good food (sometimes making, mostly eating), and spending time on creative side projects and experiments.

speakers.name: Jossi Wolf
speakers.bio: Jossi is a Software Engineer working on Jetpack Compose.

speakers.name: Joyson Fernandes
speakers.bio:
I have been building mobile applications since 2011, with experience spanning application architecture, engineering productivity, and platform development. I work closely with Android, backend, web, and DevOps teams to build scalable mobile products and the engineering systems that support them.

My recent work has focused on improving mobile development workflows by optimizing CI/CD pipelines, build infrastructure, and engineering practices. I enjoy sharing practical lessons from solving engineering challenges at scale, particularly where developer experience, reliability, and cost intersect.

speakers.name: Juhani Lehtimäki
speakers.tagLine: Serial founder, Android dev at Snapp Technology
speakers.bio:
Android developer.
Company founder.
F-Droid board member.
Trail runner.

speakers.name: Júlia Fodor-Horváth
speakers.bio: I am a tech lead who works with a team to solve challenging problems using technologies like Go, SQL, BigQuery, virtualization, and AWS. I enjoy leading collaborative efforts that turn complex requirements into practical, scalable solutions. My focus is on building reliable systems, helping my team to grow, and driving meaningful technical impact.

speakers.name: Julian Burr
speakers.bio: Senior Developer from Germany with over 15 years of experience building web apps and leading frontend teams, currently living and working down under in Australia. Pragmatic perfectionist, always looking for opportunities to learn and grow.

speakers.name: Julian Wood
speakers.bio: Julian Wood is a Principal Developer Advocate for serverless at AWS. He helps developers and builders learn about and love how serverless technologies can transform the way they build and run applications. Julian was an infrastructure architect and manager in global enterprises and start-ups for more than 25 years before going all in on serverless at AWS.

speakers.name: Julius Fischer
speakers.tagLine: Freelance Mobile Security and Development Consultant @ IsarApps
speakers.bio: Self-employed Senior Android Engineer with 10+ years of experience, specialized in secure, scalable, and user-friendly mobile applications. Delivered solutions for Deutsche Bahn, BMW, Daimler, and Allianz across freelance and employment engagements. Google Certified Android Developer, iSAQB Certified Software Architect, and Mobile Hacking Lab Certified Pentester.

speakers.name: Kadi Kraman
speakers.bio:
Kadi is an experienced mobile and Open Source developer, having delivered many mobile apps over the years. After almost a decade working for consultancies, she joined Expo in 2023 as a Software Developer, working on developer experience and education. Kadi is also an experienced speaker and teacher, with courses in Frontend Masters and Egghead.

In her spare time, she enjoys running, audio books, and crafts.

speakers.name: Kai Kenan
speakers.bio: Kai Kenan leads identity and reputation at Appdome, where his team builds the systems that decide whether a device carries a history, and whether it should be trusted to act. He has spent eight years there, moving up through engineering leadership into research, each step moving further up the stack: from hardening apps against tampering, to researching how attackers actually break them, to the question of which devices should be allowed to act at all. His hands-on background is low-level Android and iOS internals and mobile game anti-cheat.

speakers.name: Kamil Sztandur
speakers.bio: Flutter Developer at LeanCode with experience across a wide range of apps – from sports platforms to marketplace and banking solutions – with organizations of different sizes. Willing to share pragmatic insights with Flutter developers community.

speakers.name: Kanzul Fatima Arif
speakers.bio:
Kanzul Fatima Arif is an innovation leader and XR producer working at the intersection of augmented reality, spatial computing, and human-centered design. With a background in filmmaking and immersive storytelling, she helps organizations explore how emerging technologies can create more meaningful, inclusive, and engaging experiences.

Originally from Pakistan and now based in Germany, Kanzul brings a cross-cultural perspective to conversations about technology, identity, and the future of human connection. Her work spans AR, WebAR, AI, Smart glasses and next-generation spatial computing platforms, with a focus on building experiences that put people first.

speakers.name: Karlo Levak
speakers.tagLine: Abysalto - Head of Software Solutions Delivery
speakers.bio: Karlo Levak is the Head of Delivery Squad at Abysalto, where he leads the end-to-end delivery of software solutions across client and internal projects. With a background spanning software engineering, product development, and executive leadership, he combines technical expertise with operational strategy to help organizations scale efficiently. Previously a COO, he led business operations with a focus on process, planning, and cross-functional alignment. Today, he focuses on building high-performing delivery teams, optimizing processes, and creating transparent, scalable operations that enable sustainable growth.

speakers.name: Kata Zavorotchenko
speakers.bio:
Android engineer, intern manager, bootcamp class mentor.

In the past, Kata fought for performance and size wins of the Android mobile SDK installed in millions of apps. 
Since she joined Meta (Facebook) in 2018, she's working on scaling Developer Experience with reliable tooling.

speakers.name: Kathy Tafel
speakers.bio: Currently guiding software development as Technical Director at TALES Kollektiv, Kathy Tafel has lived at the intersection of technology, marketing, and consumer software since she understood the distinction. She previously led content and software teams at Apple, Meetup, Native Instruments, and Artsy, bringing Silicon Valley and Alley know-how to Germany’s Allees. A native of California, she made a brief stay in Brooklyn before settling in Berlin where she lives in Kreuzberg with her family (and a cat). She enjoys skewing mascots out of crochet when not examining and breaking down the barriers in technology which prevent the highest expression of the individual.

speakers.name: Kelly Vero
speakers.bio:
Kelly Vero is the founder of NAK3D, an AI-powered platform redefining how digital products are created, tracked, and experienced across industries. A technical founder with over 30 years in AAA video game development, Kelly has translated decades of interactive design and systems thinking into practical solutions for fashion, retail, and digital identity.
She is the author of Breaking Through Bytes (Routledge, 2025), a groundbreaking book celebrating pioneering women in tech, and How Video Games Made The Metaverse (Routledge, 2026) motivating businesses to learn from video games to build truly immersive and interoperable metaverse futures.

speakers.name: Kelvin Harron
speakers.bio: Kelvin Harron is a Lead Mobile Engineer at L+R, working across spatial technologies and with over ten years of experience building mobile apps across healthcare, marketing and point of sale. Based in Barcelona, he now works across native mobile and spatial platforms including visionOS, AndroidXR and Meta Wearables. He's a regular speaker at the award-winning Meridian Meetup and Swift Barcelona, sharing his journey into spatial computing.

speakers.name: Kenichi Kambara
speakers.bio:
I’m a mobile software engineer and generative AI specialist with over 20 years of experience across Android, iOS, and cross-platform ecosystems.

Beyond delivering production apps, I design AI-augmented engineering workflows and promote responsible human–AI collaboration in software development.

I have spoken at 27 international conferences, including AgentCon, AI Heroes, Droidcon, and DevFest. My talks focus on developer agents, Flutter, UX strategy, and globally scalable systems.

speakers.name: Kevin Galligan
speakers.bio: Kevin Galligan is the CTO of Ntive Labs. Recently partner at Touchlab. He has 20 years of professional software development experience, and has been working on Android since the first public platform release. Kevin is currently focused leveraging AI to make native mobile development more efficient.

speakers.name: Kilian Schulte
speakers.bio: Kilian is the author of Jaspr, the Web Framework for Dart developers. He is passionate about using Dart in new ways and an active contributor to the Dart ecosystem with packages like dart_mappable and stormberry.

speakers.name: Kinjal Bhavsar
speakers.bio: I am a platform engineer for spatial and camera systems with over 17 years of experience, currently working at Google. Most recently, I developed SceneCore, the scene management developer SDK for Android XR. Before that, I worked on Google's ARCore platform. My earlier work includes developing GearVR and building innovative camera and display solutions for mobile platforms.

speakers.name: Kiran Rao
speakers.bio:
Over two decades as a developer, got into Android in 2010. Adopted Kotlin in 2017, had my first attempt at KMP in 2019 (when it was still called KMM).

Worked on and off with iOS and web client technologies throughout my career, also dabbled in other cross platform technologies. Full-fledged Mobile developer since 2023.

speakers.name: Kiryl Ziusko
speakers.bio: Author of react-native-keyboard-controller and react-native-teleport. Love to develop buttery smooth UI and geek of optimized code 🤓

speakers.name: Klemens Zleptnig
speakers.tagLine: Founder | Senior Kotlin Engineer | Mobile • Backend • AI
speakers.bio:
Klemens Zleptnig is the founder of creative workline GmbH and a senior Kotlin engineer and mobile architect from Austria. He has more than 20 years of experience designing and building software products, with a focus on Android, Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Kotlin Multiplatform, Spring Boot and AI-enabled mobile applications.

He works on mobile products for companies, public-sector applications and his own software products, combining hands-on engineering with software architecture and product thinking.

Since 2013, he has been the founder and co-organizer of AndroidHeads Vienna, an Android and mobile developer community with more than 600 members and part of the Google Community Leads Platform. He also co-organized droidcon Vienna.

speakers.name: Kody Peterson
speakers.tagLine: Sr. Director, Software Engineering | GDE Flutter
speakers.bio:
Kody Peterson leads engineering teams at Foresight Sports, building apps that help golfers understand and improve their game through data and visualization. His work often lives where hardware, software, and user experience meet.

He started his career as a hands-on engineer and never fully left that mindset, staying close to architecture and technical decisions even as his role shifted toward leadership. He enjoys exploring how far modern frameworks like Flutter can be stretched when real product requirements demand it.

When not working on mobile systems, he’s usually experimenting with new tech, building side projects, or finding new ways to turn complex systems into simple user experiences.

speakers.name: Kosala Jayasekara
speakers.tagLine: Chief Technology Officer - Fixel Digital (pvt) Ltd
speakers.bio: Meet Kosala Jayasekara, Chief Technology Officer at Fixel Digital, an iOS Engineer, Software Consultant, author, and speaker based in Sri Lanka, bringing over a decade of expertise in iOS development and futuristic technologies.

speakers.name: Kostas Filios
speakers.tagLine: Head of Mobile @ Novibet | Researcher | Educator
speakers.bio:
Hi, I am Kostas! I build and lead teams that deliver mobile products used by millions of people every day. I am driven by applying computer science to real-world challenges, turning complex ideas into reliable, scalable mobile experiences.

My background includes award-winning research publications, as well as hands-on work in mobile, distributed and embedded systems. From large-scale mobile ecosystems like Novibet to national fintech and loyalty platforms, I focus on building technology that has real impact for users.

speakers.name: Kræn Hansen
speakers.bio:
Kræn is a Developer Experience Engineer working at the Voice AI startup ElevenLabs.
Previously worked at MongoDB building developer tools, such as Compass and the mongosh CLI and before that contributing to the Atlas Device SDKs, formerly Realm.
He holds a masters degree in Computer Science from the Technical University of Denmark and has built and maintained multiple TypeScript libraries and React apps and have an interest in the interoperability between native code and JavaScript and isomorphic / universal libraries.
He lives ½ hour west of Copenhagen, with his wife, two 7yo twins and 3yo - all girls.

speakers.name: Kristian Metzger
speakers.tagLine: 25 years in Games as Journalist, Publisher and CEO
speakers.bio:
Kristian Metzger has been passionate about video games since childhood. Whether as a successful esports veteran, games journalist, or game director, he has been an integral part of the games industry for more than 25 years. After spending many years as a journalist and Editor-in-Chief for leading gaming publications such as EuroGamer, he transitioned into game development and publishing.

Before founding Stratosphere Games in 2015, Kristian held leadership positions in Product Management, Communications, and Business Development at renowned companies including Splash Damage, Warchest, and Infernum. As CEO of Stratosphere Games, he has led the studio through more than a decade of successful productions, strategic partnerships, and multiple investment rounds. His vision has earned the trust of leading investors, including Skycatcher, Riot Games Investments, and 1Up Ventures.

Backed by these investments and the success of titles such as Homeworld Mobile, Stratosphere Games has grown into an internationally recognized developer of high-quality games, expanding its team to more than 35 employees.

speakers.name: Krzysztof Piaskowy
speakers.tagLine: Software Mansion, software engineer, react-native-reanimated maintainer, React Native open source contributor
speakers.bio: I'm a React Native open-source developer at Software Mansion. I contribute to the React Native core and other projects that exist in the ecosystem like Hermes, react-native-wgpu, and react-native-gesture-handler. My colleagues often joke that I'm the “Godfather of Reanimated”. Personally, I'm a robotics enthusiast and passionate about embedded programming. I reach my peak of creativity when someone says, ‘No, this is impossible to do’.

speakers.name: Kyriakos Georgiopoulos
speakers.bio: I am a Senior Android Engineer at DuckDuckGo and Google Developer Expert on Android, building apps since Android Jelly Bean. I like server-driven UI and animations, and I share weekly Jetpack compose animations, lessons, and articles on LinkedIn.

speakers.name: Leo Dion
speakers.bio:
Leo Dion is the founder of BrightDigit (https://brightdigit.com), a full-stack Swift development company he's been running since 2012. 
He specializes in end-to-end Swift solutions—from iOS/macOS/watchOS to server-side Swift—and has shipped multiple App Store apps including Bushel (macOS virtualization for developers) and Heartwitch (Apple Watch health streaming). He's an active open source contributor with Swift packages including swift-build (popular GitHub Action for Swift CI/CD), MistKit (CloudKit REST API), SyntaxKit (code generation), DataThespian (SwiftData concurrency), PackageDSL, and SyndiKit (RSS parsing). Leo hosts EmpowerApps.show (https://empowerapps.show) and has been speaking about Swift since its launch. 
He lives in Michigan with his wife Betsy and six kids. Watch his previous talks here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WVXvIso24Sc&list=PLmpJxPaZbSnBTtrr4V6bksOfLVK4uK9q6

speakers.name: Leo Picado
speakers.bio:
Wearer of many hats, former designer, full-stack developer, teacher, iOS Developer. Now: Staff Software Engineer.

Talk to me about coffee, dogs, pro-wrestling and quirky language topics.

speakers.name: Leonardo Cardoso
speakers.bio: Over a decade building production systems across backend, web, and mobile. Currently on the Cards team at Trade Republic, where he created SwiftMockKit, a Swift macros library that removed over 1,100 mock files and eliminated nearly 91,000 lines of generated boilerplate. Outside work, shipping indie iOS apps and AI projects at a7t.ai.

speakers.name: Leonid Humeniuk
speakers.bio:
I'm an iOS Software Engineer from Ukraine, currently based in Berlin, with 10 years of experience building apps across a wide range of domains — from IoT startups and life-tracking apps to photo and video editing tools, and currently approaching my second year at eBay, one of the world's largest e-commerce platforms.
Throughout my career, I've worked across the full spectrum of iOS technologies, including AVFoundation, Core Graphics, Core Text, Metal, Core Bluetooth, and Maps — gaining hands-on expertise that goes well beyond the typical iOS stack.
I've contributed to teams of all sizes, from lean two-person startups to large engineering organizations. Having seen how differently teams work across scales, I've noticed that build time is one of those silent productivity killers — small things that quietly pile up and slow everyone down, yet rarely get the attention they deserve.
I'm passionate about growing the next generation of engineers through mentoring, and I actively drive the internal European iOS community at eBay — organizing knowledge sharing sessions and talks that keep our engineers connected and growing across the continent.

speakers.name: Leopold Podmolík
speakers.bio: I'm a Senior Android Developer at Sky, working on the platform that powers several streaming services — including Peacock in the USA, SkyShowtime in Europe, and Now/Wow — reaching tens of millions of users. Most recently I've been building live sport features for Peacock. Alongside Android, I bring experience in website creation, digital marketing, and teaching IT topics, so I enjoy making complex things approachable. Outside of work I'm a lifelong football fan — I still play actively and support Chelsea FC.

speakers.name: Liudas Survila
speakers.tagLine: Senior Software Engineer @ Perry Street Software (SCRUFF, Jack'd)
speakers.bio:
Liudas is a Senior Software Engineer with over 15 years of Android development experience, currently at Perry Street Software, the team behind SCRUFF and Jack'd — apps used by over 40 million LGBTQ+ people worldwide.
He works across architecture, testing, and client DevOps, with a strong focus on the design system and UX.
When he's not writing lint rules, he's usually travelling.

speakers.name: Liviu Coconu
speakers.bio: I've been working for Snap, later SPECS, on the OS/software side for a few AR device generations since 2020. Previously, I've been active in various software development areas, particularly computer graphics research in which I own a PhD, Augmented Reality applications for digital art, but also medical software. I deeply resonate with the idea of making computing more human by moving it away from screens into the world.

speakers.name: Louis Zawadzki
speakers.bio: Senior Software Engineer at Doctolib. Passionate about testing, performance and reading the source code of libraries. Also Senior Cheese Eater and Junior Pinball Wizard.

speakers.name: Luca Caputo
speakers.bio:
I’m a Senior React Native developer passionate about creating seamless animations and writing elegant, type-safe code with TypeScript. I obsess over the details: every screen should flow beautifully, every interaction should feel intentional, and every line of code should make the product better.

When I’m not building polished, production-ready apps, you’ll find me experimenting with new animation techniques, refining codebases to pixel-perfect standards, and sharing what I learn with the developer community. For me, great software isn’t just functional, it’s delightful.

speakers.name: Lucas Josefiak
speakers.bio: Co-Founder of the open-source flutter startup Widgetbook

speakers.name: Lucie Uffoltz
speakers.bio: Tech Leader @Theodo specialised in mobile development. Lucie has been a React Native developer for 5 years. She is passionate about learning new things and sharing her knowledge with her team.

speakers.name: Lukas Klingsbo 💙
speakers.bio:
Lukas is responsible for the Flutter SDK at Supabase.
He's also a Flutter & Dart GDE and a member of the Blue Fire open source collective, which are most known for the Flame game engine. On his free time Lukas enjoys building keyboards, playing the handpan, climbing and of course; developing Flame.

speakers.name: Łukasz Chludziński
speakers.bio: Engineering Manager at Callstack with experience leading teams of up to 30 engineers building React Native applications in demanding, performance-critical environments. He is the author of The Ultimate Guide to React Native TV Development, as well as a conference speaker and podcast host, focusing on scalable architecture, performance, and multi-platform development.

speakers.name: Łukasz Lech
speakers.bio: iOS engineer with over a decade of experience. Currently building Peakme, a hiking achievements tracking app, with a small team of friends while balancing a full-time engineering role. Outside of coding, I play tennis and enjoy snowboarding, surfing, and kitesurfing.

speakers.name: Łukasz Wiśniewski
speakers.bio:
I've been doing mobile (and not only) for over 15 years now - for me it started with writing an Android app while only emulators were available. Jumped on the Flutter hype train when 1.0 got announced.

Companies/Apps I was involved with: Last.fm/TweetDeck/Twitter/Snapcat (an app for cats to take selfies)/EyeEm/DeutscheBahn/together.love/translamore/amperrank

Currently working on the next super secret project...

speakers.name: Maciej Burda
speakers.bio: Maciej Burda is an Engineering Manager at Datadog, leading the Real User Monitoring (RUM) Ecosystems team. His team owns Datadog's mobile and web SDKs and its frontend profiling features, giving developers continuous, production-grade visibility into what their apps are actually doing on real devices.

speakers.name: Maciej Synowski
speakers.bio: Self-taught software engineer with 6+ years building React Native apps - and a specialty in the screens most developers avoid: TVs, set-top boxes, and the rest of the living-room hardware that powers streaming platforms. Based in Kraków, he works end to end across mobile, web, and big-screen, where performance, clean architecture, and good UX on underpowered devices are daily constraints rather than buzzwords.

speakers.name: Maël Lilensten
speakers.bio: Maël Lilensten is a Product Manager at Datadog, leading the Real User Monitoring (RUM) product unit. RUM helps frontend developers identify, prioritise, and solve critical issues affecting the user experience on their web/mobile/desktop/smart TV/wearable applications.

speakers.name: Maia Grotepass
speakers.bio: Mobile dev since Cupcake. Android GDE. Kotlin enthusiast. Dogs make me happy.

speakers.name: Maish Saidel-Keesing
speakers.tagLine: A public speaker, a creator of things, a writer of books, a contributor to community. Senior Developer Advocate @AWS
speakers.bio:
Maish Saidel-Keesing is a Senior Developer Advocate at AWS with over 20 years of trailblazing IT expertise. His visionary leadership in designing intricate systems has driven industry evolution, with a keen focus on cloud, automation, and open-source solutions.

Renowned for his extensive knowledge in Generative AI tools, containers, DevOps, and open source, Maish empowers professionals to harness these realms effectively. His specialization in AWS Cloud, tools and agile practices reshapes business landscapes.

Maish's mission to unify Developers and Operators has revolutionized operational harmony, erased silos, and mitigated disruptions. As a passionate advocate for automation, he propels efficient architectures, driving progress that enriches both technology and lives.

speakers.name: Mangirdas Kazlauskas
speakers.tagLine: GDE Dart & Flutter | Mobile Tech Lead @Billo
speakers.bio: An experienced product-centric software engineer with a passion for learning and sharing knowledge. As a Google Developer Expert for Flutter & Dart technologies, I excel at building cross-platform apps with Flutter, and I love teaching others what I know. In my free time, I enjoy creating educational content, or just being outside and playing disc golf.

speakers.name: Manikanta Garikipati
speakers.bio: Mani is an Engineer based out of Berlin, He is working on android from its early versions and is passionate about the opportunities the Android offers to the digital ecosystem, After having worked on Android for nearly 12 years, he started working on Backend to bring the best end to end, functional experiences to the users. Mani has been involved with Android development and the Android community for a long time before joining SumUp.

speakers.name: Manoel Aranda Neto
speakers.tagLine: Team Lead | Mobile SDK Engineer @ PostHog
speakers.bio: Mobile Engineer with 14+ years of experience building, testing, and maintaining Android applications across industries — including education, transportation, logistics, documentation, and marketplaces. Experienced in designing and implementing mobile SDKs for error tracking, performance monitoring, analytics, feature flags, session replay, and surveys. Over 16 years as a Software Engineer.

speakers.name: Manuel Vivo
speakers.tagLine: Senior Staff Android Engineer @ Super Technologies
speakers.bio: Manuel Vivo is a Staff Mobile Architect and seasoned Android engineer with experience at leading companies including Capital One, Google, Bumble Inc., and Super Technologies. Beyond his technical expertise, Manuel is a dedicated mentor, accomplished public speaker, and prolific writer.

speakers.name: Manuela Sakura Rommel
speakers.bio: Manuela is a Senior Flutter Developer and Women Techmakers Ambassador. She is passionate about using technology to make a positive impact in people's lives, and is particularly focused on accessibility in her work. In addition to her professional experience, Manuela is also a co-organizer of the Berlin Flutter meetup group, where she actively shares her knowledge and learns from others in the community.

speakers.name: Marc Reichelt
speakers.bio:
Android dev since 2009. Loves Kotlin so much that he became a Kotlin trainer. On a mission to make code sharing on mobile easier using Kotlin Multiplatform + Native. ♥️
Likes helping people in achieving their goals and learning about new technologies.

speakers.name: Marc Rousavy
speakers.bio: Founder and CEO of Margelo, react-native core contributor, maintainer of VisionCamera, Nitro, react-native-mmkv

speakers.name: Marcel Kulina
speakers.tagLine: Platform Lead iOS @ adesso SE · kulina.dev
speakers.bio: Marcel is Platform Lead iOS at adesso SE, one of Germany's largest IT consultancies, with 9 years of production mobile experience. He leads mobile architecture across enterprise client projects, with deep interests in low-level systems and language tooling. He writes at kulina.dev.

speakers.name: Marcel Pintó
speakers.bio: From the sunny city of Barcelona to the cold city of Munich, Marcel is an expert Android developer that worked for small startups to big corporations like Google and currently exploring several projects as Indie-Maker with my own App Studio (https://pibi.studio)

speakers.name: Marcin Chudy
speakers.bio: Marcin is a Senior Flutter Developer at LeanCode, a software house from Poland known for building complex mobile apps with Flutter and engaging in the Flutter Warsaw community. He is currently playing a Flutter Tech Lead role in a large project for the banking sector. Previously worked with backend, and web frontend (React), finally settling on mobile and falling in love with Flutter at first sight. After work, he enjoys dancing salsa and bachata and attends metal concerts.

speakers.name: Marcin Moskała
speakers.tagLine: Consultant, contractor, trainer, author of six books about Kotlin
speakers.bio: Marcin Moskała is a Kotlin Google Developer Expert and official JetBrains training partner. A hands-on developer at heart, he turns complex language features into clear mental models that teams can apply on their very next pull request. Marcin is the author of Kotlin Essentials, Functional Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines: Deep Dive, Effective Kotlin: Best Practices, Advanced Kotlin, and, in Polish, JavaScript od podstaw and Python od podstaw, as well as Android Development with Kotlin. He also runs the largest Medium publication devoted to Kotlin and speaks regularly at conferences such as Droidcon and Kotlin Conf, where his sessions are praised for their clarity and real-world relevance.

speakers.name: Margaret Lin
speakers.bio:
Margaret is an Android Engineer based in Berlin, building mobile applications with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. She enjoys exploring software craftsmanship, developer experience, and new ways of improving everyday engineering workflows.

Recently, she has been experimenting with AI coding agents and how better context management can help developers work more effectively with AI.

speakers.name: Marina Coelho
speakers.bio: Marina is a Developer Relations Engineer at Google, focused on building native Android apps. Her mission is to help developers excel in building and growing their apps using Firebase, GCP and our suite of AI tools! Before joining the Firebase team in 2022, Marina worked as a software engineer for 8 years, 5 of which were dedicated to Android app development. She loves all things Jetpack Compose, Firebase and AI!

speakers.name: Mario Bodemann
speakers.bio: I turn tech topics into digestible content. I try to keep them a blend of information and entertainment. In my daily work I look at current developments in the security space, build Android sample code and am happy to work on feedback we are receiving from users. Please feel free to approach me about security, programming, Passkeys and Yubico. I also love to talk about community building at my GDG Berlin Android.

speakers.name: Mario Savovski
speakers.bio: Mario is a Senior Game Designer at Kolibri Games - a German mobile game developer best known for smash hits Idle Miner Tycoon and Idle Bank Tycoon. With a decade of experience in the mobile games industry, he has most recently been working on new games - trying to create next smash hit in the company's portfolio; in charge of feature & systems design, economy, balancing, and more.

speakers.name: Mariusz Stanisz
speakers.bio: Mariusz Stanisz is a Senior Software Engineer at Software Mansion, where he focuses on React Native performance and brownfield integrations. He authored a blog post included into React Native documation for the new Performance Panel introduced in RN 0.83, helping developers understand and diagnose performance issues in their applications. Mariusz previously spoke at App.js 2024, presenting "Brownfield Integration – Exploring the Limits," and later led a React Native performance workshop at App.js 2026. He enjoys sharing practical techniques for finding performance bottlenecks and believes that many React Native performance issues originate in React itself rather than the native layer. Outside of software, he's also a licensed Kraków city guide and is currently building an app to help people explore the city.

speakers.name: Mark Fairless
speakers.tagLine: Senior Engineer II at Very Good Ventures
speakers.bio: Working on mobile apps for over 15 years.

speakers.name: Mark Nolan
speakers.bio:
Mark Nolan is the App Team Lead in Berlin at Lautsprecher Teufel GmbH, where he spends his time making apps talk to things [...]

He leads Android and iOS teams building apps that connect ot real world connected devices , with a focus on maintainable architecture and real-world device integration. 
Recently, he’s been exploring Kotlin Multiplatform through open-source projects that span hardware, firmware, and mobile apps.

speakers.name: Markus Vill
speakers.bio: Markus is the Tech Lead for AAOS SDV at Google. During his eight years at the company, he has worked as a Software Engineer across backend, robotics, and Android systems, joining the SDV initiative during its initial phase. Prior to Google, Markus spent several years in various engineering and technical roles within the automotive industry.

speakers.name: Márton Braun
speakers.bio:
Márton is a Kotlin Developer Advocate at JetBrains, working on making Kotlin Multiplatform awesome. Passionate about education, he's a guest lecturer at the Budapest University of Technology and Economics.

He’s been contributing to the community through writing, speaking, and open source libraries since his university days. He is a Google Developer Expert for Android, and a co-organizer of Android Budapest.

speakers.name: Mateusz Kopciński
speakers.bio: I am graduate of Theoretical Computer Science studies on Jagiellonian University in Cracow. I am huge AI advocate and have the pleasure to be the lead engineer for Software Mansion's in-house AI team for 3 years running. Since starting this journey we experimented with real-time video processing, but then we made a pivot to edge AI with the aim of improving React Native ecosystem drive adoption.

speakers.name: Mateusz Rus
speakers.tagLine: Senior Software Engineer and Flutter Consultant
speakers.bio: Mateusz is a passionate engineer committed to continuous learning, evidenced by the successful launch of a commercial Flutter Academy and a YouTube Flutter training channel. Currently working as a Lead Engineer and Flutter Consultant, he has extensive experience leading projects and helping companies adopt Flutter and Dart in many industries such as e-commerce, health and fintech.

speakers.name: Mateusz Wojtczak
speakers.bio:
Head of Mobile @ LeanCode with almost 10 years of experience in mobile development. 
He has worked across Xamarin, React Native, and native platforms before fully committing to Flutter, now his sole focus for mobile apps at LeanCode. 
He led the Flutter at Scale in the Credit Agricole Bank Polska project and helps teams deliver high-quality apps using Patrol by LeanCode for robust testing. 
Also, the Co-founder of Flutter Warsaw, one of the largest Flutter meetups in Europe.

speakers.name: Matias Leyba
speakers.bio:
Matias is a developer with nearly five years of experience working with Flutter. Based in Uruguay and part of the Zapia AI team, he’s passionate about writing high-quality code and applying best practices across every project. With a strong focus on teamwork and collaboration, he’s committed to delivering fast, safe, and scalable solutions without compromising on quality.
An active member of the Flutter community, Matias has spoken at events like FlutterConf Latam and local meetups in Uruguay, sharing his experience on topics such as platform integrations, testing strategies, and Flutter fundamentals.

speakers.name: Matthew Jones
speakers.tagLine: Senior Innovation Enginner at Alloya Corporate Federal Credit Union
speakers.bio: Matthew "Makerinator" Jones is a Senior Innovation Engineer, Flutter developer, and maker based in Virginia Beach. He believes the best software has something physical attached to it. His presentations focus on the intersection of embedded hardware and modern app development. When he's not building fintech solutions at his day job, he's designing PCBs in KiCad, deploying Flutter on Raspberry Pi, and running Makerinator on YouTube. Matthew is what happens when a software developer gets a CNC router and too many ideas.

speakers.name: Matthias Geisler
speakers.bio: Hey I am Matthias and I work for some time now already in Tech. I use Kotlin Multiplatform before it was Multiplatform and build mostly things for Android. I co-organize some staff in Berlin like the KUG Berlin, Berlindroid, XTC Berlin and more. And of course I study as most currently the pearls of AI.

speakers.name: Matvei Novoselov
speakers.bio: Matvei (Matt) Novoselov is an iOS and visionOS Software Engineer at Sony Group in London, UK, specializing in XR and spatial computing. He is a public XR speaker and an alumnus of the Apple Developer Academy, as well as a winner of the Apple Swift Student Challenge 2025. Matvei is also the co-author of a scientific research paper on XR and spatial computing presented at the International Conference on Social Robotics (ICSR) and published by Springer. His work focuses on creating immersive experiences and exploring new possibilities for spatial applications on Apple platforms.

speakers.name: Mauricio Miguez
speakers.bio:
Mauricio is a Uruguayan Software Engineer with a passion for continuous learning and sharing best practices in software development. Currently a Flutter Engineer at Holafly, he works within cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality mobile experiences, while also helping drive collaboration and engineering standards across the organization.

Since 2021, Mauricio has been working extensively with Flutter, striving to elevate software quality and push the boundaries of industry standards. He has also spoken at notable events such as Fluttercon USA, Flutter Conf Latam and GDG Montevideo, where he enjoys engaging with the developer community and sharing insights from the field.

speakers.name: Max Heimbrock
speakers.bio: Max studied Games Engineering at TU Munich, where he focused on XR and AI technologies in games. He previously worked for Niantic in London, working on their spatial SDK for gaming. Now he is working at LiveKit to bring voice agents into games.

speakers.name: Maxim Salnikov
speakers.tagLine: AI Dev Tools & Platforms Solution Engineer at Microsoft, Tech Communities Lead, Keynote Speaker
speakers.bio: Maxim Salnikov is a tech and cloud community enthusiast based in Oslo. With over two decades of experience as a web developer, he shares his extensive knowledge of the web platform, cloud computing, and AI by speaking at and providing training for developer events worldwide. By day, Maxim plays a crucial role in supporting the development of cloud and AI solutions within European companies, serving as the Senior Solution Engineer at Microsoft focusing on the AI-native developer tools & platforms. During evenings, he can be found running events for Norway's largest web and cloud development communities. Maxim is passionate about exploring and experimenting with Generative AI possibilities, including AI-assisted development. To share his insights and connect with like-minded professionals globally, he founded and organized the inaugural Prompt Engineering Conference, the first of its kind on a global scale.

speakers.name: Maximilian Krause
speakers.tagLine: Founder, Kuatsu | React Native Engineer & Consultant
speakers.bio: React and React Native Engineer with eight years of experience. Passionate about performance optimization and AI integration. Founder at Kuatsu, a boutique mobile app agency.

speakers.name: Md Noman Khan
speakers.tagLine: Full-stack SDE at Tutero | Org Admin at The Palisadoes Foundation
speakers.bio: Noman Khan is a Full Stack Software Development Engineer at Tutero and previously worked as a Software Development Engineer specializing in Flutter at Snipe, where he was also a Founding Team Member and played an integral role in shaping the company’s vision and driving development initiatives. Noman has a strong commitment to open-source development, actively participating in Google Summer of Code (GSoC): selected as a participant in 2022, serving as a mentor in 2023, and contributing as an org admin in 2024, all with The Palisadoes Foundation.

speakers.name: Md Risul Karim
speakers.tagLine: Senior Unity Developer, Core Game Tech
speakers.bio:
I’m a Senior Software Engineer specializing in game and XR development, with more than a decade of experience building games, engine features, development tools, and immersive applications.

At Kolibri Games, I develop shared technologies that support multiple game teams, with a focus on performance, scalability, and maintainable architecture as part of my team Core Game Tech.

Previously, I worked at Voodoo and Wargaming on mobile and AAA game technology, gameplay systems, production pipelines, and developer tooling.

Earlier in my career, I led teams creating video games, augmented and virtual reality experiences, motion-controlled applications, robotics projects, and hardware simulations.
My core expertise includes Unity, C#, .NET, C++, OpenGL, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, and 3D mathematics. I enjoy solving complex gameplay and engine problems and turning experimental XR ideas into reliable, production-ready experiences.

speakers.name: Mehmet Ali Ustaoglu
speakers.bio: A software engineer with a genuine passion for continuous learning, technical research, and tackling complex development challenges. Interests focus on expanding the capabilities of frameworks like Flutter for non-standard ecosystems and integrating AI workflows. Enjoys analyzing architectural constraints, exploring new technologies, and sharing knowledge and technical findings with people.

speakers.name: Michael Gerasymenko
speakers.bio: Customer and quality focused mobile engineer in love with mobile platforms. I've been building software for quite a while: over 16 years of software development experience, 14 years of iOS. I have experience working on great products and I am excited to see them used.

speakers.name: Michael Goderbauer
speakers.bio: Michael is a Software Engineer at Google. He has been working on Flutter and Dart since 2017.

speakers.name: Michael Lazebny
speakers.bio:
I’m Michael, a software developer with over 5 years of experience building applications across a wide range of domains and scales. I specialize in Flutter and Dart, and have contributed to more than 15 projects, from MVPs to large-scale systems.

Through my experience, I’ve developed a strong understanding of what makes apps and codebases maintainable, scalable, and production-ready—and what common patterns tend to cause problems over time.

I regularly share insights about Dart and Flutter on X, LinkedIn, and my blog (https://lazebny.io), where I also publish a newsletter followed by 800+ readers. I run a Telegram channel (@mdevnotes) with over 1,000 subscribers. To date, I’ve delivered 6 public talks—3 at local meetups and the rest published on my YouTube channel.

Currently I work at OLX as a Senior Software Engineer at Core Platform Team, drive company-wide initiatives and support in developing all company apps, including main OLX app, Otomoto and Otodom.

speakers.name: Michael Tamm
speakers.bio: Michael Tamm is a full stack developer, agile coach, UX enthusiast, and the lead developer of the AUTOVIO app. With his extensive background in QA automation, Michael has spent the last few years working to combine technical robustness with a first-class user experience. He firmly believes that true app quality doesn't just mean bug-free and fast, but also delivering an excellent UX. He occasionally publishes technical articles in computer magazines and gives talks at various IT conferences.

speakers.name: Michael Thomsen
speakers.tagLine: Dart & Flutter Group Product Manager @ Google
speakers.bio: Michael leads the product management team for Frameworks and Languages at Google. This includes Dart, Flutter, Genkit, and Go. He originally joined the Dart and Flutter teams back in 2015.

speakers.name: Michal Harakal
speakers.bio:
With a long-standing career as a software developer, Michal now works as a data scientist at Deutsche Telekom AG. He is the creator of SKaiNET, an innovative Kotlin-based machine learning framework. His extensive toolbox includes a wide range of languages, technologies, and frameworks, with Kotlin, Kotlin Multiplatform, and Android remaining central to his work.
Michal is passionate about sharing his knowledge and experiences at meetups and conferences. He actively contributes to open-source projects, conducts workshops, and writes insightful articles.

speakers.name: Michal Jenicek
speakers.bio: https://jenicek.dev/posts/aboutme

speakers.name: Michał Pierzchała
speakers.bio: Part of R&D Incubator team at Callstack. Passionate about building mobile and web experiences, high quality JS tooling and Open Source. Core React Native Community & Jest contributor. Built agent-device. Space exploration enthusiast.

speakers.name: Michał Sawicz
speakers.bio: With Ubuntu for nearly 20 years, I've worked through a number of user experiences we've designed and built. Now focused on Mir, the display server library.

speakers.name: Miguel Juarez Lopez
speakers.bio: ex-Lyft, ex-Microsoft, Miguel now leads the engineering team at bitdrift.io, where he is building the next-generation of mobile observability tools. He previously led Lyft's resilience teams and helped scale their infrastructure to support their vast mobile fleet. Miguel has been writing software for 20+ years.

speakers.name: Miguel Ramos
speakers.bio: Miguel Ramos is a Product Manager at Google, where he leads Firebase SDKs and Firebase AI Logic, the AI product that lets mobile and web apps call Gemini models securely from client code. His work at Google focuses on making gen AI production-ready for consumer apps. He has over 25 years of experience in the software development industry, and more than 15 years as a Product Manager creating SDKs, frameworks, and tools for developers.

speakers.name: Mihaela Mihaljevic Jakic
speakers.tagLine: Senior iOS Architect & AI Tooling @ CodeWeaver
speakers.bio: Senior iOS Architect & Developer with 15+ years on Apple platforms. Builds AI-powered developer tools for the Apple ecosystem, working across the full stack, from iOS and macOS apps to Swift server backends. Creator of Cupertino, an open-source MCP server for Apple documentation with 600+ GitHub stars. Previously spoke at NSSpain XIII (2025) on modular API-driven architectures. Based in Zagreb, Croatia.

speakers.name: Mike Borodin
speakers.bio: Besides my job at Appsfactory GmbH I also organize Flutter meetups in Leipzig, Germany.

speakers.name: Mike Slinkman
speakers.bio: Mike has been developing (accessible) apps for over 5 years. Since 2023, Mike has joined Abra to fully specialize in making apps accessibly by supporting accessibility features and assistive technologies. Next to developing apps Mike also helps other companies in making their apps more accessible.

speakers.name: Mikita Fedarenka
speakers.bio: Mikita Fedarenka is a Berlin-based Creative Director with 20 years in game development and over a dozen shipped titles, including genre benchmarks like June's Journey and Agent Alice. His career spans art direction, UI design, and production-pipeline work across studios such as Wooga, Ten Square Games, and Moonlit Games, which he co-founded. He now builds his own AI-native creative tools, derived.pro and Clustrd, designing the UI workflows that bring generative AI into real production pipelines from gaming to fashion ecom.

speakers.name: Milica Aleksic
speakers.tagLine: Senior Software Engineer @Novium | Public Speaker | Co-founder Women In Tech Nis
speakers.bio:
I’m a senior software engineer with expertise in mobile development, particularly React Native. I focus on building performant, scalable applications and a great user experience.

Beyond code, I’m passionate about community and mentorship. As co-founder of Women in Tech Niš, I organize events, mentor aspiring professionals, and advocate for diversity in tech. I’ve also spoken at international conferences and hosted large-scale events as an MC, combining technical knowledge with clear and engaging communication.

I am driven, detail-oriented, and always learning. I bring a mix of technical depth, people-centered leadership, and a genuine love for building things that matter.

speakers.name: Mo Javad
speakers.bio: Mo is the Head of Mobile at Theodo, having worked on dozens of projects with startups and established enterprises to create cross-platform mobile and web application in React & React Native. He has spoken at over 25 international conferences, organises the React Native London Conference & Meetup, and is a React Native Core Contributor.

speakers.name: Mohammad Azam
speakers.bio:
Mohammad Azam is a veteran developer who has been professionally writing software for more than a decade. Azam worked as a lead mobile developer for many fortune 500 companies and played an integral role in their success. Azam is also a top Udemy instructor for mobile with more than 40K students. Apart from Udemy Azam is also a frequent contributor to LinkedIn with top rated courses. 

Azam is also a veteran international speaker and has been professionally speaking since 2006. In his spare time Azam likes to exercise and plan his next adventure to the unknown corners of the world.

speakers.name: Mohit Karekar
speakers.bio: Principal Engineer at Zalando focusing on client platforms - web and mobile apps. I own the speed of delivery and reliability aspects of the platform and some major topics I’ve worked on include over-the-air updates for mobile apps, E2E automated testing platform, observability SDKs with OpenTelemetry and load testing at scale. On the side I love working with compilers, and wrote a short series to build one in TypeScript: tinyurl.com/compiler-ts

speakers.name: Moses Roth
speakers.tagLine: Amazon Developer Advocate for Fire TV and Alexa+
speakers.bio: Moses is a Developer Advocate for Fire TV and Alexa+ at Amazon, where he engages the developer community through talks, articles, and video learning series. He manages the developer forum and content workstreams. In his free time, he likes to write and spend time with his wife Basak and daughter Ayla.

speakers.name: Mykhailo Kushnir
speakers.bio:
Mykhailo Kushnir is the founder and CTO of DestiLabs, a software agency that builds AI-powered products and internal tools for clients across healthcare, fintech, and e-commerce. With deep expertise in Python, cloud infrastructure, and AI/ML systems, he has shipped production systems ranging from voice AI assistants to GPU-accelerated image processing pipelines.

At DestiLabs, Mykhailo has built a comprehensive AI operations layer that connects 17+ business tools through Claude Code and MCP (Model Context Protocol), turning conversational AI into the primary interface for managing client projects, finances, hiring, and growth. He writes about AI infrastructure, agency operations, and the economics of building vs buying AI platforms on LinkedIn.

Previously, he led engineering teams building scalable backend systems and data pipelines. He is based in Lisbon, Portugal and works with clients across Europe and North America.

speakers.name: Nadav Mordechai
speakers.bio: Nadav is a product and people leader with 15+ years of experience. He enables companies to design and launch new products, transform their working methods, and streamline complex processes.

speakers.name: Nainy Sahani
speakers.tagLine: Marketing Director, Tales of Us GmbH
speakers.bio: Nainy Sahani is a marketing and transformation consultant based in Berlin. With a background spanning multiple continents and sectors, she specializes in the integration of strategic content development and advanced technology solutions. Nainy has led significant initiatives to establish brand foundations and develop comprehensive marketing strategies, particularly in the digital content sectors. An accomplished speaker and advisor, she actively contributes to discussions and developments in digital marketing, sustainable practices, and gender parity in the tech industry. Nainy holds a Bachelor of Science in Electronic Media and a Diploma in Media & Communication, underpinning her passion for merging creative content with educational outreach in the digital landscape.

speakers.name: Nelson Osacky
speakers.bio: Former Gradle/Soundcloud/Square. Based in Berlin.

speakers.name: Nicola De Zolt L.
speakers.bio: Father, coder, radio ham as IU2EKC

speakers.name: Nicola Giancecchi
speakers.tagLine: Freelance iOS Engineer, POP Digital Studio
speakers.bio:
I'm a freelance iOS developer and UX/UI designer with 14 years of experience on Apple platforms, working solo through my own studio based in San Marino. I cover the full product lifecycle - from UX design to native development on the Apple platforms, through to App Store release. Beyond native development, I also work with hybrid tools and web projects. 
I've worked on 70+ projects in the past, ranging from large companies like Zalando and Wire to local startups. I'm a four-time Apple WWDC Scholar (2014, 2015, 2017, 2018). I love working at the intersection of engineering and design and owning both sides of a product in.

speakers.name: Nicolas Guillot
speakers.tagLine: Founder & CTO @ alt+1 | Sea turtle enthusiast
speakers.bio:
Hi! I’m Nicolas, a developer with over 25 years of experience, now working as a freelance mobile app developer.

My journey has taken me from programming MS-DOS games to building electronic test systems for the oil industry, before transitioning to mobile development in 2017.

Everything changed during an eco-volunteering mission in French Polynesia, where I monitored sea turtles. This experience inspired *“We Spot Turtles!”*, a side project that has since become one of my main activities as a freelancer.

In 2022, an unexpected encounter with an Australian helped propel the project onto the international stage, eventually leading to it being featured by Google in a global campaign.

Today, I build this solution using Flutter, co-organize the Flutter Nantes meetup, and aim to expand the impact of this application dedicated to sea turtle conservation worldwide.

speakers.name: Nicole Terc
speakers.bio: Android GDE, Boardgame lover, videogame addict and origami enthusiast. I self-taught myself to code and I've been fooling around with the Android ecosystem for more than 10 years. I've participated in a diverse variety of projects for several clients around the world, including video streaming, news, social media and public transport applications. Regardless of where my current adventures take me, I love finding time to play with new things and share my experience :)

speakers.name: Nikhil Singh
speakers.bio: Loves tinkering around with a keyboard and having a ball whenever not

speakers.name: Niklas Holloh
speakers.bio: Niklas Holloh is Competence Center Lead at adesso SE, where he leads a 21-person team specializing in banking apps. Previously at Deutsche Bank as iOS Lead, he architected the app for 500k daily logins and launched Germany's first Apple Pay. He excels at delivering banking applications at scale that combine top-tier user experience with regulatory compliance and uncompromising security.

speakers.name: Noam Efergan
speakers.tagLine: Self taught iOS developer and general nerd
speakers.bio: A self taught iOS developer with a flaming passion to breaking stuff.

speakers.name: Norbert Klockiewicz
speakers.bio: Norbert is an on-device AI engineer at Software Mansion and the core maintainer of react-native-executorch. He co-built Private Mind, a fully on-device AI app for iOS and Android. He spends his time getting models to run fast on phones and shipping them behind clean React Native APIs, and he spoke about the challenges of doing exactly that at App.js Conf 2026.

speakers.name: Ole André Vadla Ravnås
speakers.bio: Creator of Frida · Security Researcher at NowSecure

speakers.name: Oliver Okrongli
speakers.tagLine: TestBalloon author, Multiplatform Software at infix
speakers.bio: Oliver has been shaping and creating software from backend to frontends. He is the author of TestBalloon, a next-generation Kotlin test framework. Before, he has helped to maintain Kotest, and contributed to several libraries of the Kotlin ecosystem as well as the Kotlin compiler. Can be found on GitHub (OliverO2) and the kotlinlang Slack (Oliver O). When not developing, he is most probably in deep talks, dancing, snowboarding or F18 catamaran sailing whenever he gets a chance.

speakers.name: Olla Ashour
speakers.tagLine: Senior iOS Engineer@ SumUp | Accessibility Advocate & Strengths-Based Coach
speakers.bio:
Salam! I’m Olla — a Senior iOS Engineer at SumUp, the fintech empowering small businesses worldwide, part of the global team in Berlin. 

I fell in love with iOS development for its human-centered interaction, usability, elegant user experience, and rich ecosystem — a passion that continues to inspire my journey toward building inclusive and impactful products. 
As an Accessibility Advocate and Strengths-Based Coach, I’m passionate about creating inclusive experiences, teaching, sharing knowledge, and building spaces where others can learn, grow, and make an impact — both in tech and in their personal lives.

speakers.name: Oscar Tigreros
speakers.bio: Flutter has been a game-changer for me, allowing me to build beautiful and functional apps even with my (sometimes questionable) coding skills. It's a journey of constant learning, filled with both triumphs and epic debugging sessions. Today, I want to share some of those stories, the wins and the stumbles, in the hope that it resonates with all of you, whether you're a seasoned pro or just starting out

speakers.name: Óscar Martín
speakers.bio: Óscar is a Director of Platform at Very Good Ventures who fell in love with Flutter in 2019, with around 10 years in the IT industry, mostly focused on Mobile development. GDE in Flutter and Dart since 2023. He´s helped build cool Flutter showcases like I/O Photo Booth or Holobooth.

speakers.name: Pamela Hill-Galloway
speakers.bio: Pamela is a Developer Advocate for Kotlin Multiplatform at JetBrains and has more than 20 years of experience writing desktop, web and mobile apps.

speakers.name: Paolo Abela
speakers.tagLine: CEO & Creative Director @ Fatum Games, Senior Software Engineer @ Unity
speakers.bio: Paolo Abela is an Italian studio founder, game developer, and consultant specialized in multiplayer games. Since 2013, he has run multiple studios and worked hands-on on multiplayer games at scale such as "Ariokan", "Overknights", and "Eggscape". He also helps Indie and AA teams make and ship multiplayer games and likes to spread knowledge through conference talks and LinkedIn posts for those who come after.

speakers.name: Patrick .McGrath
speakers.tagLine: Product Strategy Consultant & Fractional CPO, Higher Agency
speakers.bio:
At the core of my work lies a deep belief in the transformative power of play, specifically gaming. Games are more than entertainment; they're platforms for storytelling, learning, and connection. This conviction drives my dedication to pioneering titles that are remembered.

With over 13 years in the free-to-play game industry, I've contributed to creating and growing multiple billion-dollar titles, blending creative game design with strategic monetization. At the helm of Moonlit Games and in leadership roles across several gaming studios, my focus has been on fostering innovative teams that pioneer titles that resonate with hundreds of millions globally.

In an industry constantly evolving, I pride myself on staying ahead of the curve, guiding projects from concept to reality, and pushing the boundaries of interactive entertainment. I'm always on the lookout for new challenges and like-minded professionals keen on shaping the future of gaming.

speakers.name: Patryk Kacperski
speakers.bio: Mobile developer since 2017. Started with iOS and moved to Flutter after a couple of years. Now a Flutter developer at LeanCode

speakers.name: Paul King
speakers.bio: Paul is a Staff Specialist Software Engineer at AKQA Leap, focusing on mobile and web application development. An early adopter of Flutter with over seven years of experience, he has led the architecture and development of several high-profile applications. Most recently, Paul led the delivery of the official Eurovision Song Contest app, successfully scaling it to millions of users globally. He is passionate about clean architecture, strict tooling, and sharing the battle-tested strategies needed to ship rock-solid, production-grade applications.

speakers.name: Paul Lammertsma
speakers.tagLine: Developer Relations Engineer, Android @ Google Switzerland GmbH
speakers.bio: Paul supports developers with Android integrations at Google as a Developer Relations Engineer and has been passionate about building amazing Android experiences since its early days.

speakers.name: Paulina Strychacz
speakers.bio:
Paulina has worked as an Android Developer for over a decade. She's been a Kotlin fan for more than 6 years. Berlin based.
Privately she travels a lot, loves to dance UrbanKiz and Tango and recently discovered calligraphy.

speakers.name: Payam Zahedi
speakers.bio: I build mobile apps for a living and make them prettier, funnier and faster for fun. I'm a software engineer with 8+ years in mobile and the author of toastification, an open-source Flutter package that makes toast notifications beautiful and effortless. I also lead the Persian Flutter community, where I help developers learn, share and grow together. Based in Berlin, I'm on a mission to prove that "efficient" and "delightful" belong in the same widget.

speakers.name: Peko Lin
speakers.bio: Peko Lin is a Senior UI/UX Designer at Snowprint Studios, currently shaping the user experience for Warhammer 40,000: Tacticus. Blending a unique background in contemporary art and game design, they have an extensive track record of shipping impactful features across multiple platforms—including mobile, PC, Switch, VR, and Apple Vision Pro. Having honed their skills at industry leaders like Wooga and Ubisoft, Peko excels in end-to-end UI/UX workflows from initial wireframes to game engine implementation. They are currently focused on the practical intersection of design and AI, exploring how automation can streamline production pipelines without compromising design integrity.

speakers.name: Perttu Lähteenlahti
speakers.bio: Perttu is a designer and software engineer, with 10 years of experience designing and building web and mobile applications. He loves hacking with technology and building things. When he’s not sitting in front of a computer, he likes to renovate apartments.

speakers.name: Peter Bergner
speakers.tagLine: Game Developer / Tech Consultant / Applied AI Engineer @ Peter Bergner Consulting
speakers.bio: Peter Bergner is a game developer and 15-year veteran who's shipped on just about everything - mobile, PC, console, and VR, from Studio Fizbin's narrative adventure Minute of Islands to blockchain esports to digital board games. A serious anime, manga, and gacha fan, he's run the games area of a 20,000-visitor anime convention and consulted on a Japanese gacha title. His running obsession: the tools and workflows that let a small team out-ship a much bigger one.

speakers.name: Peter Friese
speakers.bio:
Peter is a Staff Developer Advocate on the Firebase at Google, helping developers build amazing experiences and high quality apps using Firebase and AI.

With a passion for empowering developers and fostering innovation, Peter works tirelessly with the Firebase team to make his vision of “cutting short the time to magic” a reality.

Peter is also the author of the book "Asynchronous Programming with SwiftUI and Combine: Functional Programming to Build UIs on Apple Platforms" and host of the YouTube show "Firebase After Hours", in which he and his colleagues explore Firebase in a light-hearted and fun setting.

He has written code in BASIC, C, ObjectPascal, Java, Kotlin, Xtext, JavaScript, TypeScript, Objective-C, and a number of home-grown DSLs - but his all-time favourite is Swift.

speakers.name: Peter Kurzok
speakers.bio:
Software Architect. Photographer. Musician. Dad.

Peter wrote his Diploma thesis on a multitouch finger detection library for Multitouch Tables. Then came the iPhone and changed everything. He has been doing mobile development ever since. Today He works as a Software Architect for MaibornWolff an IT Consultancy. He has worked on Apps for BMW, Rolls-Royce, Mini, DigitalCharging Solutions, Deutsche Post and many more.

Peter is a regular speaker at conferences and Meetups and back in the day even gave a lecture at university: https://bit.ly/4mnGYC6

speakers.name: Peter Molnar
speakers.tagLine: iDad and Apple Fanboy since the first white MacBook.
speakers.bio:
How it started: Microsoft Windows 3.11, DOS 6.22, dBase and FoxPro.
How it’s going: macOS, iOS, Swift and occasionally Objective-C.

speakers.name: Phil Zakharchenko
speakers.bio: Phil is an Apple platforms engineer obsessed with software craft and intentional design. At Apple, he worked on flagship macOS features including the modernized menu architecture, Window Tiling, and Stage Manager. In 2023, he joined Software Applications Incorporated as the first hire to build Sky, a reimagining of the Mac interaction paradigm. The company was acquired in 2025 by OpenAI, where Phil is continuing to build thoughtful experiences and dreaming up new interactions for Apple platforms.

speakers.name: Pierre-François Maillard
speakers.bio: Dr. Pierre-François Maillard is a security analyst specialized in AI and low-level security. He earned his engineering/master's degree in cybersecurity at ESIEA (France), and his PhD from TCG CREST (India), with a focus on adversarial machine learning. Over the past years, he has spoken at academic and industry conferences worldwide (c0c0n, ICSRS, etc.) and authored various articles in journals (MISC, JCVHT, etc.). He currently works at eShard as a Security Analyst and Customer Success, where he focuses on applying time travel debugging and AI to reverse engineering.

speakers.name: Pierre-Yves Ricau
speakers.bio: After 12 years at Square in San Francisco, I just moved back to France! I enjoy being with my family, rollerblading, baking and reading sci-fi.

speakers.name: Piotr Prus
speakers.bio: Piotr Prus is a Google Developer Expert for Android and a regular Droidcon/DevFest speaker. His talks and workshops focus on the craft of visual UI on Android: Jetpack Compose, canvas, animations, particle emitters, AGSL shaders, and fluid screen transitions.

speakers.name: Piotr Rogulski
speakers.bio: Flutter developer at LeanCode, always keeping up-to-date with what's new in Dart & Flutter. Fan of functional programming and immutability. In his spare time – a language nerd who is currently into learning Japanese.

speakers.name: Pooja Bhaumik
speakers.bio: Pooja Bhaumik, founder of Prehearsal: a speaking coach platform, Google Developer Expert for Flutter, former DevRel at FlutterFlow, and the author of Flutter Essential Training, an exclusive LinkedIn Learning course. She has spoken at over 20 conferences in the past five years, including in-person international events like Fluttercon Berlin, Flutter Conf LATAM, and F3 Prague. She is also passionate about mentoring, especially women in STEM, and has participated in numerous panels on the subject.

speakers.name: Prasanna Bhat
speakers.bio:
Prasanna Bhat is a software engineer at Uber focused primarily on iOS infrastructure and developer platforms, with additional experience building backend systems in Go. He enjoys solving complex engineering problems across app performance, reliability, scalable architecture, and developer tooling. His interests span mobile platform engineering, and emerging AI-assisted developer workflows. 

Outside work, he enjoys running, hiking, and building side projects that explore creative uses of technology.

speakers.name: Preethi Srinivas
speakers.bio: Preethi is UX Researcher at Google, with current focus on Jetpack Compose. She has passion for understanding the needs supporting elegant developer experiences. Prior to Google, she worked on designing products and services influencing delightful behavior change.

speakers.name: Rafa Moreno
speakers.bio: Currently a software engineer working on making your trips experience delightful on the Airbnb app

speakers.name: Rafael Mendiola
speakers.bio: Product maker and experienced React Native engineer, now building an AI-native engineering operations startup, okthink.ai

speakers.name: Raul Menezes
speakers.tagLine: Lead iOS & Design System Engineer @ Bumble
speakers.bio: I'm an old school passionate iOS engineer! Still remember the good times with Objective-C but don't miss the cross-platform frameworks! Now SwiftUI enthusiastic and everything related with Design Systems

speakers.name: Ravin Anderson
speakers.bio: Ravin Anderson is a Software Engineer at Google working in Jetpack XR on the ARCore team. They focus on building core spatial perception APIs like depth sensing, spatial anchoring, and Geospatial positioning within the Jetpack XR SDK. Their work enables Android developers to seamlessly integrate real-world environmental understanding into apps for AI glasses and headsets.

speakers.name: Renuka Kelkar
speakers.bio: Renuka Kelkar is a trailblazing figure in the tech industry, known for her multifaceted roles as Co-Founder of ARNA Genext Solutions, Google Developer Expert for Flutter and Dart, and Founder of the TechPowerGirls Community. With a passion for fostering diversity and inclusion, she serves as an organizer for GDG London and a WomenTechmaker ambassador. Renuka's impactful contributions were recognized with the prestigious Diversity and Inclusion Award from Google in 2023. Her dynamic speaking prowess has earned her the prestigious title of Most Active Speaker for the past two years consecutively on Sessionize, cementing her reputation as a driving force in the tech community.

speakers.name: Richard Brough
speakers.tagLine: Chief Technology Officer, Blue Beck Ltd
speakers.bio:
Richard is the CTO at Blue Beck Ltd, an experienced software professional focussed on Machine Learning / AI and Apps with a passion for Open Source AI and a strong interest in novel ways AI & Machine Learning can be used. Richard started his career at RARE as a console game developer, and went on to backend service, machine learning and mobile development.

In 2025 Richard spoke at numerous conferences including Global AI Barcelona, Dev Talks Bucharest (one of the largest developer conferences in Eastern Europe), DevBCN, Tech Mids Conference and NDC Manchester, these have ranged from high level talks about Open Source AI models, to experiments with MCP and a detailed explanation about model alignment with DeepSeek R1.  

Here is a video with some clips of his talks https://vimeo.com/1105715168

speakers.name: Richard Topchii
speakers.bio: Richard is an Apple Platforms Developer working as a consultant. He has more than 10 years of experience developing apps from scratch, improving existing apps or developing tools such as SDKs and libraries. In his free time he also creates open-source libraries, such as CalendarKit, speaks at local meetups or releases new videos about iOS development on his YouTube channel.

speakers.name: Rob Whitaker
speakers.tagLine: Senior iOS engineer & native accessibility specialist
speakers.bio: Rob is a Senior iOS Engineer and a mobile accessibility specialist with a background that includes time on the accessibility team at Apple. He’s an invited expert on the WCAG Mobile Accessibility Task Force, a conference speaker, and the author of Developing Inclusive Mobile Apps, a book for developers who believe that building for everyone isn’t a nice-to-have.

speakers.name: Robert Odrowaz-Sypniewski
speakers.bio: Robert is a Senior Flutter Developer at LeanCode a software house from Poland specializing in Flutter apps.

speakers.name: Robert Procter
speakers.tagLine: Lead UI/UX Designer (Principal) and Solo Indie Game Dev @ Place of Birds, ex-Wooga
speakers.bio:
A Principal UI/UX designer, illustrator, animator and solo game developer based in Berlin. Rob has been in the games industry since 2011 and over his career has worked in educational gaming, social casino and social/casual titles, on some of the highest grossing in-genre titles on the app store, including Heart of Vegas and later leading the UI/UX team on Hidden Object game June's Journey.

Currently he is pursuing solo indie game development on a title to be announced soon!

speakers.name: Robey Beswick
speakers.tagLine: Agents and agents and loops and agents.
speakers.bio: Solutions architect. Come from a background of mathematics, went into architecture in tech consulting and then moved into the big tech sphere. I now work as a solutions architect and have accidentally become involved in agentic federation and web tokens.

speakers.name: Robin Schönau
speakers.bio: Robin Schönau is a Flutter Tech Lead at phntm in Cologne. He has been developing software for more than 16 years, with a focus on Flutter and workflow-heavy business applications with side quests in game dev. His current research explores how AI-assisted development changes when project knowledge moves from Markdown files into living graphs.

speakers.name: Rohan Joshi
speakers.bio: Rohan is a mobile engineer with extensive experience in developing and scaling end-to-end applications for unicorn startups. He has successfully transformed ideas into high performance apps, achieving millions of downloads. Rohan brings in hands-on knowledge and real-world insights in space of mobile development.

speakers.name: Rosário Fernandes
speakers.bio: Rosário P. Fernandes (@thatfiredev) is a Developer Relations Engineer on the Firebase team at Google, focused on helping developers integrate Firebase and Generative AI into their mobile apps. With a passion for developer communities, he can often be found hanging out with other Android, Firebase, or Flutter developers. In his free-time, he enjoys playing videogames, reading comic books and watching movies.

speakers.name: Rui Alonso
speakers.tagLine: Senior Engineer II at Very Good Ventures
speakers.bio: I’m a Senior Engineer at Very Good Ventures with over a decade of experience in mobile development and more than four years dedicated to scaling the Flutter and Dart ecosystem. For the past few months, I've been working on producing enterprise-level and open-source code within a fully AI-assisted environment.

speakers.name: Rutger Roffel
speakers.bio:
Head of AI at New Nexus (NL)

AI-driven innovator shaping next-gen digital systems through adaptive design and cross-domain expertise.

speakers.name: Saeid Rezaeisadrabadi
speakers.bio:
I'm a Senior Mobile Engineer with over 8 years of experience architecting, developing, and maintaining complex mobile applications at scale. I specialize in performance optimization and build tooling with deep, hands-on expertise taking production apps through the full software development lifecycle.
A self-described build tools geek, I care deeply about writing clean, maintainable, and performant code, with a strong commitment to user privacy and secure, user-centric experiences. I bring that same discipline to the systems and pipelines that power mobile development at enterprise scale.
Beyond engineering, I'm a dedicated mentor and collaborative team player who actively contributes to high-impact technical decisions. I thrive at the intersection of deep technical craft and team growth, always expanding my knowledge and pushing the boundaries of what great mobile engineering looks like.

speakers.name: Salih Guler
speakers.bio: Salih is a Senior Developer Advocate at AWS with a strong focus on frontend and mobile app development, developer experience, and serverless architecture. With a background in building scalable mobile and web interfaces, he brings hands-on expertise to developer communities around the world. He’s passionate about creating intuitive developer tools and open source projects, often blending frontend craft with cloud infrastructure. Outside of work, Salih is a dedicated runner, comic book enthusiast, and a dad who balances code, curiosity, and creativity—always exploring new skills, from making music to architecture.

speakers.name: Sandra Jurek
speakers.bio: Robotics engineer turned software engineer. I'm currently a Founding Product Engineer at a private Swiss bank, after spending seven years helping build the Chase UK app. Along the way I've worked on products for brands including Jaguar Land Rover, Boots, Wagamama and Nando's. I like making large codebases feel smaller and enjoy speaking about front-end architecture, design systems, React Native and developer experience. Outside work you'll usually find me playing board games or making something crafty.

speakers.name: Santosh Yadav
speakers.tagLine: Google Developer Expert Angular, GitHub Star and Principal Developer Advocate @ CodeRabbit
speakers.bio: Santosh works as a Principal Developer Advocate at CodeRabbit and is a GDE for Angular, GitHub Star, Nx champion and Microsoft MVP. He loves contributing to Angular and its eco-system. He is co-founder of This is Learning. He is also the author of the Ngx-Builders package and part of the NestJsAddOns core Team. He is also running This is Tech Talks talk show, where he invites industry experts to discuss different technologies.

speakers.name: Sasha Denisov
speakers.tagLine: Brainform.ai, CTO, Cloud.AI, Flutter, Dart and Firebase GDE
speakers.bio: Sasha is CTO at Brainform.ai with over 20 years of experience architecting scalable enterprise systems. With a strong engineering background, his expertise spans frontend, backend, cloud infrastructure, mobile development, and AI — from cloud-based generative AI to on-device solutions. He specializes in building robust, production-ready products using a variety of technologies and frameworks. Sasha has delivered solutions across fintech, digital media, and entertainment.
